tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page background. Pure black in dark (landing B4 palette), pure white in light.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Raised panels only: the booking widget, dialogs, the featured price tier, code. Most content sits flat on `bg` with hairlines.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed backgrounds, input fills, table header rows, meter tracks.

tokens.name: square
tokens.usage: The dark square of the 8x8 board motif in hero and footer backgrounds. Decorative only; never put text on it without `surface` behind.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline 1px borders and dividers between sections, cards and rows. Decorative: never the only boundary of a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Borders of inputs, secondary buttons and checkboxes. Holds 3:1 on `bg`, `surface` and `surface-raised` in both themes.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Headings and body copy on `bg`, `surface` and `surface-raised`.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary copy on `bg`, `surface`, `surface-raised` (at least 6.9:1).

tokens.name: ink-subtle
tokens.usage: Meta lines, timestamps, captions (at least 4.9:1 on every surface).

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: The one primary action per view: Book a free discovery call. White on black in dark, black on white in light. Replaces the green CTA.

tokens.name: on-primary
tokens.usage: Text and icons on `primary`.

tokens.name: primary-hover
tokens.usage: Hover fill of `primary`.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Monochrome emphasis for active and selected states (current carousel dot, timeline progress, chosen slot). Equal to `ink`: v6 has no brand hue on actions.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an `accent` fill (primary button).

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Fill behind a selected chip, slot or open calendar day.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Status only: the availability dot, success badges, the booked check. Never on a button.

tokens.name: success-soft
tokens.usage: Fill behind success badges.

tokens.name: award
tokens.usage: Amber for rankings and wins only (Enactus #3, #5; WEKUSA 7/9). Text-safe on `bg` and `award-soft`.

tokens.name: award-soft
tokens.usage: Fill behind `award` text on an award badge.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Form errors and the CVE badge only. Always paired with a word or icon.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Focus ring, 2px with 2px offset. Ink gives the highest contrast against both canvases.

tokens.name: board-light
tokens.usage: Light squares of the ChessBoard. A physical board reads the same in both themes, so it stays mid-light.

tokens.name: board-dark
tokens.usage: Dark squares of the ChessBoard, dithered with `board-light` in a 4px checker for the retro 1-bit look.

tokens.name: piece-white
tokens.usage: White chess pieces, always with a 1px `piece-black` outline so they hold on `board-light`.

tokens.name: piece-black
tokens.usage: Black chess pieces and the outline of white ones (≥7:1 on both board squares).

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: Hero headline only, once per page (landing Heading 1, text-6xl), solid ink with meaningful line breaks. 48/48 under 820px, 36/40 under 640px.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Page titles and the tagline reveal (Heading 2, text-5xl). 36/40 under 640px.

styles.name: lead
styles.sample: I build secure, measured web systems.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Migrated the platform from Flask to Django with a modular multi-app architecture.
styles.usage: Default paragraph and list text (Body 3, text-base). 16px is the floor for reading copy.

styles.name: small
styles.usage: Meta lines, card footers, form help text (Body 6 / Caption 2, text-sm).

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Section notation and small meta in sentence case (Caption 4, text-xs). `ink-subtle`.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Tags, metrics, dates in timelines, certificate IDs (text-xs, mono).

styles.name: metric
styles.usage: Stat numbers in the StatBlock, award ranks and case study results (text-3xl). Poppins with tabular figures since v7, so every number people read is in the one family.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-text gap, tag inner vertical padding.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between tags; button icon gap.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Tag horizontal padding; small stacks.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Page gutter on mobile; button horizontal padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card padding; grid gap.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Page gutter on desktop; gap between heading and content.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Gap between blocks inside a section.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Board square size in the hero motif.

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Vertical padding of a home-page section (64px under 640px).

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Tags, badges, inputs' inner elements.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, small cards.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Project and certificate cards, image frames.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Status pill, theme toggle.

shadow.note: Borders, not shadows. The dark theme uses none; the light theme allows one soft lift on hover.

tokens.name: shadow-hover
tokens.usage: Card hover. Dark: a brighter hairline; light: a soft lift.

tokens.name: content-max
tokens.usage: Max width of the page column.

tokens.name: prose-max
tokens.usage: Max width of paragraphs and project write-ups.

tokens.name: nav-height
tokens.usage: Sticky top nav height.

tokens.name: icon-sm
tokens.usage: Icons in buttons, nav, inline with 13–15px text.

tokens.name: icon-md
tokens.usage: Icons in cards and list rows.

tokens.name: icon-lg
tokens.usage: Standalone icons, empty states.

tokens.name: target-min
tokens.usage: Smallest pointer target on desktop (WCAG 2.2 target size). Carousel dots, inline icon buttons.

tokens.name: target-touch
tokens.usage: Every tap target under 820px: nav items, footer links, buttons, slots, calendar days.

tokens.name: focus-width
tokens.usage: Focus ring width, solid `focus` colour.

tokens.name: focus-offset
tokens.usage: Gap between a control and its focus ring.

tokens.name: bp-sm
tokens.usage: Phones: single column, display-xl-mobile, section padding space-16.

tokens.name: bp-md
tokens.usage: Nav collapses to the menu button; footer to two columns; targets grow to target-touch.

tokens.name: bp-lg
tokens.usage: content-max: the page column stops growing.

tokens.name: z-nav
tokens.usage: Sticky SiteNav.

tokens.name: z-dialog
tokens.usage: ConfirmDialog and its scrim.

tokens.name: z-toast
tokens.usage: Toasts sit above dialogs.

tokens.name: z-skip
tokens.usage: The skip link, above everything when focused.
